metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve forearm muscle pain and tightness.

Each of these exercises works a little differently, they're going to target different muscles. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give forearm pain relief within 30 seconds.

Let us which exercise works best for you!
